G6801.definition:
δέρρις , -εως, ἡ 
 (δέρος = δέρμα) [in LXX:  Exo.26:7  ff. (יְרִיעָה),  Zec.13:4  (אַדֶּרֶת), etc. ;] 
 a skin :  Mrk.1:6  (D, from Za, l.with; Swete, in l; Rec., Edd. τρίχας; cf. MM,  Exp. , x).†
 (AS)

G6802.definition:
1.  absolute   to be lord   or  master, gain the mastery  , (Aeschulus Tragicus) 
2. with  genitive   to be lord   or  master of  , (Homeric Hymns), etc.; δεσπόζειν φόβης  to own   the lock of hair, (Aeschulus Tragicus);  metaphorically   to master  , δ. λόγου (Aeschulus Tragicus) 
3. with  accusative   to lord it over  , (Euripides) (ML)

G6803.definition:
1.  the power of a master   over slaves, or  the relation of master   to slaves, (Aristotle Philosopher) 
2.  absolute sway, despotism  , (Isocrates Orator) (ML)

G6804.definition: to be second  : δευτ. τινί  to play second to . .  , (Plutarch) (ML)

G6805.gloss: a second book of the law
G6805.definition: a second book of the law

G6808.definition: a bite, sting  , (Xenophon Historicus):  metaphorically , δ. λύπης (Aeschulus Tragicus) (ML)

G6809.definition: a pointing out, manifestation, explaining, shewing  , (Thucydides); δ. ποιεῖσθαι = δηλοῦν, (Thucydides) (ML)

G6810.definition:
1.  a crossing over, passage  , δ. ποιεῖσθαι (Herdotus Historicus) 
2.  a means   or  place of crossing  , (Herdotus Historicus): δ. ποταμοῦ  a ford  , (Thucydides):  a bridge  , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6813.definition: to carry over   or  across, to transport  , δ. τὸν στρατὸν κατὰ γεφύρας (Herdotus Historicus); ἐς τὴν νῆσον τοὺς ὁπλίτας (Thucydides) (ML)

G6814.definition: to live through, pass  , χρόνον, βίον (Plato Philosophus), etc.:—; absolute   to spend one's whole life  , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G6815.definition:
1.  to shout out, proclaim, publish  , (Aeschulus Tragicus):—;Pass.  to be the common talk  , (Lucian) 
2.  to cry out  , (Thucydides) 
3. Mid.  to contend in shouting  , (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

G6816.definition:
1.  false accusation, slander, calumny  , ἐπὶ διαβολῇ εἰπεῖν (Herdotus Historicus); διαβολὰς ἐνδέχεσθαι to give ear to  false accusations  , (Herdotus Historicus); ἐμὴ δ.  the slanders   against me, (Plato Philosophus) 
2.  a quarrel, enmity  , (Thucydides) (ML)

G6822.definition: a marking off by lines  , (Plato Philosophus):  a geometrical figure, diagram, outline  , (Plutarch) (ML)

G6823.definition:
1.  to mark out by lines, delineate  , (Plato Philosophus) 
2.  to draw a line through, cross out, strike off the list  , (Plato Philosophus); δ. δίκην  to strike   a cause  out of the list, cancel, quash   it, (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

G6825.definition:
1.  to slip through   a hole or gap, (Thucydides):  absolute   to slip through, slip away  , (Herdotus Historicus) 
2. with  accusative   to evade, shirk  , (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

G6826.definition: to warm through  , (Plato Philosophus), etc.:—; Pass.  to be heated  , by drinking, (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

G6827.definition:
1.  a disposition, arrangement  , (Plato Philosophus) 
2.  the composition   in a work of art, as opposite to εὕρεσις, (Plato Philosophus) 
3.  a disposition   of property, = διαθήκη, (Plato Philosophus) 
4.  a disposing of, selling, sale  , (Plutarch) 
5.  a   man's  disposition  , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G6841.definition: to escape notice  , διαλαθὼν εἰσέρχεται (Thucydides): with  accusative  pers.  to escape the notice of  , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6843.definition: Dep.  to leap across  , τάφρον (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6845.definition:
1.  a loosing one from another, separating, parting  , τῆς ψυχῆς καὶ τοῦ σώματος (Plato Philosophus); δ. τοῦ σώματος its  dissolution  , (Plato Philosophus); ἡ δ. τῆς γεφύρας  the breaking   down the bridge, (Thucydides):  the disbanding  , of troops,  Xen.;   ἡ δ. τῆς ἀγορᾶς  the time of   its  breaking up  ,  Hdt.;   τὴν δ. ἐποιήσαντο  broke off   the action,  Thuc.;   δ. γάμου  a divorce  , (Plutarch) 
2.  an ending, cessation  , κακῶν  Eur.;   πολέμου (Thucydides):  absolute   a cessation of hostilities, peace  , (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

G6846.definition:
1.  to go astray from  , τῆς ὁδοῦ (Thucydides):  to fail of obtaining  , τινός (Thucydides) 
2.  absolute   to fail utterly  , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G6847.definition: as attic law-term,  evidence given to prevent   a case from coming to trial, (Demosthenes Orator), etc. (ML)

G6848.definition:
1.  to measure through, out   or  off  , χῶρον δ.  to measure   lists for combat, (Iliad by Homer):—;Pass., ἡμέρα διαμεμετρημένη  measured by the clepsydra  , (Demosthenes Orator) 
2.  to measure out in portions, distribute  , (Xenophon Historicus), etc.:—;Mid.  to have measured out to one, receive as one's share  , (Oracle quoted in Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G6852.definition: to adorn with flowers  , (Lucian):—;Pass.  to be variegated  , (Plutarch) (ML)

G6858.definition: to make to cease  :—; Mid.  to rest between times, pause  , (Plato Philosophus):—;Pass.  to cease to exist  , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6859.definition: to threaten violently  , (Herdotus Historicus):—;so in Mid., (Aeschines Orator) (ML)

G6860.definition:
1.  to send off in different directions, send to and fro, send about   or  round  , (Herdotus Historicus) 
2.  to send over   or  across  , (Aristophanes Comicus):  to transmit  , ἐπιστολήν (Thucydides); so in Mid., (Thucydides) (ML)

G6863.definition:
1.  to fall away, slip away, escape  , (Xenophon Historicus) 
2. of reports and rumours,  to spread abroad  , (Xenophon Historicus) 
3.  to fall asunder, crumble in pieces  , (Plato Philosophus) 
4.  to fail utterly, go quite wrong  , (Aristophanes Comicus) (ML)

G6864.definition: to make very wide, dilate  , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6865.definition: Dep.  to spar with, skirmish with  , τινι (Plutarch) (ML)

G6866.definition:
1.  to blow through  : —; Pass., αὔραις διαπνεῖσθαι (Xenophon Historicus) 
2.  to breathe between times, get breath  , (Plutarch) 
3.  intransitive   to disperse in vapour  , (Plato Philosophus) (ML)

G6871.definition:
1.  to cast   or  shoot through  , (Odyssey by Homer) 
2.  to cast   or  throw about  , a dog,  to wag   the tail, (Xenophon Historicus) 
3.  to throw about  , as nuts or money among a crowd, (Aristophanes Comicus) 
4.  intransitive   to plunge  , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6874.definition: to shake violently: to reduce to anarchy  ,  Luc.;   διασεσαλευμένος  unsteady  , (Lucian) (ML)

G6876.definition:
1.  to scatter abroad, scatter to the winds, disperse  , Lat.  dissipare , (Odyssey by Homer) 
2.  to disband   an army, (Herdotus Historicus): Pass.  to be dispersed  ,  aorist  1 and  perfect   participle  διασκεδασθέντες, διεσκεδασμένοι (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G6877.definition:
1.  to get quite ready, equip  , (Lucian):—;Pass.,  perfect   participle  διεσκευασμένοι  dressed  , (Plutarch): —;Mid.  to prepare for oneself, provide  , (Thucydides):  to equip oneself  , (Xenophon Historicus) 
2. Mid., διασκευασάμενος τὴν οὐσίαν  having disposed of one's   property, (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

G6885.definition: to cleave   or  rend asunder  , (Odyssey by Homer), etc.:—;Pass.  to be cloven asunder  , (Iliad by Homer); of soldiers,  to be separated  , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6886.definition: disposition, arrangement  , of troops, (Herdotus Historicus); of topics, (Lucian) (ML)

G6887.definition:
1.  to stretch to the uttermost  , τόξον (Herdotus Historicus):  to stretch out  , τὰς χεῖρας (Xenophon Historicus) 
2.  intransitive   to extend, continue  , (Aristotle Philosopher) 
3. Mid. and Pass.  to exert oneself  , (Xenophon Historicus), etc.; διατεινάμενος  at full speed  , (Xenophon Historicus);  with all one's force  ,  Theocr.;   διατείνεσθαι πρός τι  to exert oneself   for a purpose, (Xenophon Historicus) 
4.  to maintain earnestly, contend for  , τι (Demosthenes Orator) 
5. in strict sense of Mid.  to stretch out for oneself  , δ. τὰ βέλεα  to have their   lances  poised  ,  Hdt.;   δ. τὸ τόξον  to have one's   bow  strung  , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G6888.definition:
1.  to melt, soften by heat  , (Aristophanes Comicus) 
2. Pass., with  perfect  -τέτηκα,  to melt away, thaw  , (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G6893.definition: to turn away from   a thing:—;Pass. with  future   middle ,  aorist2    middle  -ετραπόμην and  passive  -ετράπην [ ᾶ],  to be turned from one's purpose, to be perplexed  , (Demosthenes Orator) (ML)

G6895.definition:
1.  to run across   or  over   the sea, (Odyssey by Homer) 
2.  metaphorically   to run through  , τὸν βίον, τὸν λόγον (Plato Philosophus) 
3.  absolute   to run about  , Lat.  discurrere , (Aristophanes Comicus) 
4. δ. μέχρι  to penetrate   to, (Plutarch) (ML)

G6896.definition:
1.  a way of spending time  : hence,  a pastime   (pass-time),  amusement  , (Aristophanes Comicus) 
2.  serious employment, study  , (Aristophanes Comicus), 
3.  a way of life, living  , δ. ἐν ἀγορᾷ (Aristophanes Comicus) 
4. in bad sense,  a waste of time, delay  , (Euripides); in  plural , (Thucydides) (ML)

G6898.definition: to shew light through, to dawn  , (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G6899.definition: to burn through  , (Plutarch):—; metaphorically   to inflame  , (Plutarch) (ML)
